verdict.rationale: monday.com documents its own no-code AI agents: you describe a workflow in plain words to create one, and agents can be assigned items and update statuses. That makes an AI triage agent plausible, but nothing documents automatic triage or prioritization of incoming bugs or tasks. Creation-event subscriptions (create_item) are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented automatic triage/prioritization of new bugs and tasks, agents triggered on item arrival without custom code, priority/severity assignment examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks

citations.quote: Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent in minutes.
Build agents for your exact needs. Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results.
Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.
